## Changes

- Isolated architecture-specific control-flow decoding from the no-return proof engine.
- Kept the existing AArch64 proof and Ghidra fallback behavior unchanged.
- Added regression coverage for decoder-defined instruction widths.
- Added a bounded AArch64 proof for stripped IL2CPP interface-dispatch helpers.
- Applied the proven helper name and ABI through Ghidra APIs before parallel decompilation.
- Added negative unit fixtures and an end-to-end synthetic AArch64 Ghidra gate.
- Added a validated, optional interface-dispatch contract to `script.json` imports.
- Persisted exact type and dispatch identities in the Ghidra project for later call-site proof.
- Added a bounded SSA origin lattice for exact allocation-based interface dispatch proofs.
- Added a candidate-only Ghidra P-code adapter that records proofs without changing the program.
- Published exact interface-call proofs as transactional Ghidra call overrides before parallel decompilation.
- Reported compact rejection reasons and bounded call-site samples for unresolved interface calls.
- Matched helper and dispatched receivers through bounded SSA identity roots, including casts and unanimous control-flow merges.
- Recognized exact allocations reached through Ghidra-proven object-new thunk chains.
- Recovered exact TypeInfo origins from uniquely validated read-only GOT pointers.
